title: Tsar Bell
status_note: On a pedestal in the Kremlin since 1836; never rung.

place.label: Moscow Kremlin, beside the Ivan the Great Bell Tower
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

maker: Ivan Motorin and his son Mikhail Motorin (Moscow)

timeline.event: Casting work begins under Ivan and Mikhail Motorin
Bell finally cast in its casting pit
Troitsky fire: the hot bell cracks and an 11.5 t piece breaks off
Raised from the pit onto a pedestal under architect Auguste de Montferrand

tiers.everyday: The Tsar Bell in the Moscow Kremlin is about 202 tonnes of bronze and has never been rung. It cracked in a fire in 1737 while still in its casting pit, and a huge piece broke off.
tiers.student: Cast in 1733–1735 by Ivan and Mikhail Motorin, the Tsar Bell (about 202 t, 6.14 m high, 6.6 m across) cracked during the Troitsky fire of May 1737, losing an 11.5 t fragment. It was raised onto a pedestal in 1836 and is a monument of Russian founding, never a working bell.
